description: Shared foundation for the variant matrix + categoryStore: type additions, shared cart-product helper, variant-aware price/barcode/stock logic, a variant-bearing mock product, and categoryStore mirroring brandStore. Pure/data/store layer only — no screen wiring yet. Depended on by FEAT-002 and FEAT-003. All changes are additive and backward-compatible (absent variant/options => identical behavior).
steps: src/types/product.ts: add `export interface ProductOption { name: string; values: string[] }` and `export interface ProductVariant { id: string; sku?: string; barcode?: string; price?: number; stockQty: number; optionValues: Record<string,string> }`. Add optional `options?: ProductOption[]`, `variants?: ProductVariant[]`, `supplierId?: string`, `supplierName?: string` to ProductMaster. All optional/additive.

src/utils/cartProduct.ts (NEW): export `toCartProduct(master: ProductMaster, uom: ProductUOM, branchId?: string, variant?: ProductVariant): Product` — id = `${master.id}_${uom.id}` when no variant else `${master.id}_${uom.id}__${variant.id}`; price = resolveCartPrice(master, uom, branchId, variant).price; name appends variant option values (e.g. `${base} (แดง/M)`) when variant present, else keeps existing `uom.ratio > 1 ? name (unit) : name`; all other fields identical to the current inline copies (code, barcode uom.barcodes[0] ?? master.barcode, category, cost uom.costPrice, vat, unit, stockQty Math.floor(master.stockQty/uom.ratio)). Import Product from '../types/sale'. Also export `masterDisplayStock(master: ProductMaster): number` = master.variants?.length ? sum of variants[].stockQty : master.stockQty. Absent `variant` MUST be byte-identical (id/price/name/stock) to today.

src/utils/priceResolver.ts: change signature to `resolveCartPrice(master, uom, branchId?, variant?: ProductVariant)`. Before the existing resolve, add: `if (variant?.price != null) return { price: round2(variant.price * uom.ratio), source: 'base' };`. Keep everything else unchanged. Import ProductVariant from '../types/product'.

src/data/mockProducts.ts: change findProductByBarcode return type to `{ product: ProductMaster; uom: ProductUOM; variant?: ProductVariant } | null`; search order = variant barcodes first (loop product.variants, match variant.barcode -> return the product's default/base uom + variant), then uom.barcodes (return product+uom, no variant), then master.barcode. Add >=1 variant-bearing product to MOCK_PRODUCTS: master id `p30` (NO underscore), code `P030`, one base uom `u30_1`, options e.g. [{name:'สี',values:['แดง','น้ำเงิน']}], variants with ids like `v30_red`/`v30_blue`, each with unique barcode and stockQty. Extend the DEV validation IIFE to also fold each variant.barcode into seenBarcodes for duplicate detection.

src/store/productStore.ts: replace deductStock body with: `const [left, variantId] = productId.split('__'); const masterId = left.split('_')[0];` then for each product return unchanged unless `p.id === masterId || p.id === productId`; when matched and `variantId && p.variants?.length` map variants deducting the matching variant's stockQty via `Math.max(0, v.stockQty - qty)`; otherwise `stockQty: Math.max(0, p.stockQty - qty)`. Keep raw qty (no ratio multiply).

src/store/categoryStore.ts (NEW): mirror src/store/brandStore.ts exactly for Category — zustand+persist name 'pos-categories', seed `[...MOCK_CATEGORIES] as Category[]`, exported `getCategories/getCategory(id)/addCategory/updateCategory/deleteCategory` + `getCategoryProductCount(id)` counting `useProductStore.getState().products.filter(p => p.categoryId === id).length`, each mutation `logAction('หมวดหมู่', 'เพิ่ม'|'แก้ไข'|'ลบ', ...msg, { categoryId })`, export `useCategoryStore`.

Add tests (every store test MUST mock react-native + AsyncStorage per context.json): src/utils/__tests__/cartProduct.test.ts (no-variant byte-identical to legacy output; variant id + variant price used; masterDisplayStock sums/equals); src/store/__tests__/productStore.test.ts (REAL ids p1_u1_1__<variantId>: variant deduction correct, others untouched, non-variant id deducts master, negative guard qty>stock=>0); extend src/utils/__tests__/priceResolver.test.ts (variant wins; scales by uom.ratio; variant.price==null falls through to branch then base); src/data/__tests__/findProductByBarcode.test.ts (variant barcode -> variant; uom barcode on variant product -> no variant; master barcode on plain product unchanged); src/store/__tests__/categoryStore.test.ts (add/update/delete + getCategoryProductCount reflects productStore + persist key 'pos-categories').
acceptance_criteria: `npm run lint` reports no type errors.

`npx vitest run src/utils/__tests__/priceResolver.test.ts src/engine/adapter/__tests__/cartAdapter.test.ts` => 19 pre-existing tests still pass (5 priceResolver incl. new cases + 14 cartAdapter unchanged).

`npx vitest run src/utils/__tests__/cartProduct.test.ts src/store/__tests__/productStore.test.ts src/store/__tests__/categoryStore.test.ts src/data/__tests__/findProductByBarcode.test.ts` => all new tests pass.
toCartProduct(master,uom) with no variant produces the exact same id/price/name/stock as the current inline copies (regression guard).
verification: npx vitest run src/utils src/store/__tests__/productStore.test.ts src/store/__tests__/categoryStore.test.ts src/data src/engine/adapter/__tests__/cartAdapter.test.ts
findings:
LANDED (feat/vmat worktree, committed locally, NOT pushed).

EXPORTS FOR FEAT-002/003:
- src/utils/cartProduct.ts: `toCartProduct(master, uom, branchId?, variant?)` and `masterDisplayStock(master)`. toCartProduct with NO variant is byte-identical to the old inline copies (id `${master.id}_${uom.id}`, barcode `uom.barcodes[0] ?? master.barcode`, name `uom.ratio>1 ? '${name} (${unit})' : name`, stock `Math.floor(master.stockQty/uom.ratio)`). With a variant: id `${master.id}_${uom.id}__${variant.id}`, barcode `variant.barcode ?? uom.barcodes[0] ?? master.barcode`, name `${baseName} (${Object.values(variant.optionValues).join('/')})`, price from variant. POSSaleScreen (line ~43) + WebPOSScreen (line ~126) should migrate their inline toCartProduct to this import; kiosk keeps its local copy.
- src/utils/priceResolver.ts: `resolveCartPrice(master, uom, branchId?, variant?)` — 4th arg variant. If `variant.price != null` returns `{ price: round2(variant.price * uom.ratio), source: 'base' }` BEFORE branch/central resolve; otherwise unchanged. Import ProductVariant from '../types/product'.
- src/types/product.ts: new `ProductOption { name: string; values: string[] }` and `ProductVariant { id: string; sku?: string; barcode?: string; price?: number; stockQty: number; optionValues: Record<string,string> }`. ProductMaster gained optional `options?: ProductOption[]`, `variants?: ProductVariant[]`, `supplierId?: string`, `supplierName?: string`.
- src/data/mockProducts.ts: `findProductByBarcode(barcode, products)` now returns `{ product; uom; variant? } | null`; search order = variant barcodes -> uom barcodes -> master.barcode. On a variant match it returns the product's default (isDefault) / first uom + the variant.
- src/store/productStore.ts: `deductStock(productId, qty)` splits productId on '__' first (variant id), then `left.split('_')[0]` for master id. Variant id path deducts the matching variant.stockQty; otherwise master.stockQty. No ratio multiply (raw qty).
- src/store/categoryStore.ts (NEW, mirrors brandStore): persist name 'pos-categories'. Exports: `useCategoryStore`, `getCategories()`, `getCategory(id)`, `addCategory(data)`, `updateCategory(id, updates)`, `deleteCategory(id)`, `getCategoryProductCount(id)` (counts useProductStore products by categoryId). New-category id format `cat-<ts>-<rand>`. logAction module label 'หมวดหมู่'.

VARIANT-BEARING MOCK PRODUCT (src/data/mockProducts.ts, appended after p23):
- master id `p30`, code `P030`, master barcode `8850999030001`, name 'เสื้อโปโล Signature', categoryId c4.
- base uom id `u30_1` ('ตัว', isDefault, barcode `8850999030001`).
- options: [{ name: 'สี', values: ['แดง','น้ำเงิน'] }].
- variants: `v30_red` (barcode `8850999030101`, stockQty 22, optionValues {สี:แดง}, NO price) and `v30_blue` (barcode `8850999030102`, stockQty 18, optionValues {สี:น้ำเงิน}, NO price). Neither variant sets a `price`, so cart price falls through to uom/branch/central resolve. DEV validation IIFE now also folds variant.barcode into duplicate detection.

VERIFICATION: `npm run lint` introduces ZERO new type errors (13 errors pre-exist on clean feat/vmat tree — confirmed by git stash — in BranchSelector/DatePicker/PermissionMatrixScreen/RoleManageScreen/WebUserStaffScreen/errorTracking; unrelated baseline). Tests: 19 baseline green (14 cartAdapter + 5 priceResolver) + new: priceResolver +3 variant cases (8 total), cartProduct 8, productStore 5, categoryStore 5, findProductByBarcode 6. Full verify command => 6 files / 43 tests passed.
